verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's pricing page says compute is "Billed by the second" at a GiB-second rate with "No one-hour compute minimum," and paused sandboxes incur storage charges only. The docs add that paused sandboxes cost no compute and that a soft TTL can pause a sandbox when it goes idle, so you pay only while it runs. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on confirmation of the billing behavior, and no clarity on whether the GiB-second meter counts allocated resources or actual consumption.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can pay per second only for the compute a sandbox actually uses
